Image1 ORIGINAL Uber Eats has highest authority for information-circle glyph geometry, thin optical stroke, proportions, title/subtitle alignment and spacing. Only top preparing/arrival2lines are target; no other source content. Image2 Japanese native mock SECONDARY wording/layout; replace its rough Unicode info substitute with accurate source outline-circle lowercase-i icon. Centered exact heading「お食事を準備しています」, MeiryoBold20/28 logical px. Centered subtitle「お届け目安 14:35〜14:50」 MeiryoRegular12/16 with small precise source info-circle aligned at right of subtitle. Tracking0. Keep familiar2line hierarchy, modest compact spacing. White rounded card on PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, subtle neutral border, extremely soft downward shadow. Main ink#1D1D1D, subtitle#6E6E6E, info icon slate#526173. This source state is neutral: NO added colored accent, CTA, progress steps, delivery number, ready badge, illustration, map, order/payment detail, countdown or invented information. All Japanese and numerals complete without clipping; no excessive margins, bold subtitle, broad mint, gloss or watermark.

reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
